title: Ordinary scalar evaluation commutes with a K-flat resolution
statement: For normalized additive ordinary scalar extensions O and scalar evaluation data E [lem-sfb-ordinary-scalar-evaluation-model], assume extension along a preserves finite limits. For arbitrary complexes P,I,D,V, a K-flat P, a chain map b:D -> Hom(P,I), and a quasi-isomorphism t:V -> D, extension sends t and t tensor 1_P to quasi-isomorphisms; tensoring t and strict scalar tensor(t) with P gives quasi-isomorphisms; scalar evaluation after strict scalar tensor(t) tensor 1_P is the scalar evaluation of t followed by b. No K-flatness of D or V, flatness of the terms of P, K-injectivity of I, or derived choices is assumed.

proof.text: An additive exact extension preserves homology; hence it preserves t. The K-flat tensor theorem shows that t tensor 1_P is a quasi-isomorphism, and exact extension preserves this too.

The natural normalized isomorphism nu identifies strict scalar tensor(t) with restriction of extension(t). Restriction is exact, so cancellation of nu shows that strict scalar tensor(t) is a quasi-isomorphism. Tensoring it with P preserves that property.
On every generator (s tensor x) tensor p the two evaluation routes are s tensor b(t(x))(p). Apply tensor generation and the stored scalar evaluation formula.

theorem resolution (O : Scalars.{c, v, r} (J := J))
    (E : RepresentativeData.{c, v, r} (J := J) O)
    {R S : Sheaf J CommRingCat.{max c v r}} (a : R ⟶ S)
    (ha : PreservesFiniteLimits (O.E a))
    (P I D V : StrictScalarHom.Complex.{c, v, r} R)
    (hP : CochainComplex.IsKFlatIndependentCoefficients (J := J) (R := R) P)
    (b : D ⟶ homComplex (R := R) P I) (t : V ⟶ D) (ht : QuasiIso t) :
    QuasiIso ((extension O a).map t) ∧
    QuasiIso ((coefficientTotalTensor.{r, c, v} J R).map (Prod.mkHom t (𝟙 P))) ∧
    QuasiIso ((extension O a).map
      ((coefficientTotalTensor.{r, c, v} J R).map (Prod.mkHom t (𝟙 P)))) ∧
    QuasiIso ((coefficientTotalTensor.{r, c, v} J R).map
      (Prod.mkHom ((StrictScalarHom.tensor.{c, v, r} a).map t) (𝟙 P))) ∧
    (coefficientTotalTensor.{r, c, v} J R).map
      (Prod.mkHom ((StrictScalarHom.tensor.{c, v, r} a).map t) (𝟙 P)) ≫
      E.scalarEvaluate a P I D b = E.scalarEvaluate a P I V (t ≫ b)
